keyVerseDR: "I am come that they may have life and may have it more abundantly." (Jn 10:10)

level1.title: Jesus, My Shepherd
level1.story: Jesus is the Good Shepherd. He calls His sheep by name. They know His voice and follow Him.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!

activity.title: The Good Shepherd's sheep
activity.intro: Make fingerprint sheep following Jesus, the Good Shepherd.
activity.prompt: Jesus the Good Shepherd at the gate, with fingerprint sheep following His voice

level2.title: The Gate for the Sheep
level2.story: Jesus said the shepherd enters by the gate, and the sheep hear his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out. The sheep follow him because they know his voice, but they run from strangers. Jesus said, "I am the gate for the sheep. Whoever enters through Me will be saved." He said, "I came so that they might have life and have it more abundantly."
level2.keyLine: I am come that they may have life and may have it more abundantly.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How can we tell Jesus' voice from other voices?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Good Shepherd, call me by name. Amen.
